items.guidance: Trace where HOMEPAGE_CONFIG_DIR is read in the Next.js source to confirm whether it holds YAML configuration that the app reads (and may seed or write on first start), rather than uploads or database data. If the directory is only read-only configuration, report whether it could be baked into the image at build time from the Dockerfile instead of relying on a mounted directory. If the app writes to it at runtime, report that as durable local state.
